data_references.description: RNA-seq data from mouse normal lung tissues and tumors
DNA methylation profiling data from mouse normal lung tissues and tumors
Whole genome sequencing data from human BEAS-2B and mouse LLC cells, and mouse normal lung tissues and tumors

Murine Microenvironment Cell Populations-counter for immune deconvolution
Tool for duplex sequencing variant calling
Tool for generating mutational signature matrices

key_results.description: HDM-treated mice showed significantly higher tumor bioluminescence signals between 3 and 4 weeks after LLC cell implantation
HDM-treated mice showed significantly increased lung weight
HDM did not increase mutational burden in BEAS-2B or LLC cells in vitro
HDM exposure did not significantly increase mutational burden in normal lung tissues or tumors in vivo
HDM-treated normal lung tissue exhibited 1,390 differentially expressed genes; tumor tissue showed 599 DEGs
HDM-driven tumor promotion was abolished in Il17a−/− but not Il1b−/− mice

methods_summary.study_design: in vitro cell culture experiments and in vivo orthotopic lung cancer mouse model
methods_summary.sample_size: n = 9 mice/group for main experiments, n = 3 mice/group for sequencing experiments
methods_summary.analysis_pipeline: 1) HDM exposure in vitro (BEAS-2B and LLC cells) and in vivo (C57BL/6J mice), 2) Orthotopic lung tumor implantation with LLC-GLF cells, 3) Whole-genome duplex sequencing for mutation analysis, 4) RNA-seq for transcriptomic analysis, 5) DNA methylation profiling using Illumina arrays, 6) Integrated multi-omics analysis, 7) Immune deconvolution using mMCP-counter, 8) Functional validation in Il1b−/− and Il17a−/− mice
statistical_methods: two-way ANOVA with Bonferroni post hoc

data_availability_statement: The raw FASTQ files and processed datasets generated in this study have been deposited in GEO (RNA-seq: GSE308855; DNA methylation: GSE317298) and SRA (WGS: PRJNA1402948). All analysis code is available at https://github.com/shamsalazzam/code_Multi-omics-profiling, and all data and code are publicly available without restriction.
